method.consistency: every seed selects a checkpoint after step 0
method.decision: A1 beats A0 on the validation set if and only if p <= alpha and the consistency condition holds
method.null: sign flips of each question's differences from step 0, jointly across every evaluation and seed, with the fixed selection rule re-applied to every flipped curve over all recorded evaluations
method.rng: numpy PCG64(20261109); columns in sorted pair-ID order

selection_rule.after_stop: training and evaluation continue to the planned last step; those evaluations are recorded as not selectable and never change the selection
selection_rule.candidates: step 0 (the base model) and every 5 optimizer steps
selection_rule.early_stopping: selection stops after 3 candidate evaluations in a row without improvement; no later checkpoint is selectable
selection_rule.final_step: evaluated and reported when it is not a multiple of 5; never a candidate
selection_rule.ties: the earlier step (values compared to 12 decimal places)

method.statistic: mean over seeds of (whole-corpus MRR@10 at the selected checkpoint - at step 0)

notice: A selection-aware comparison on synthetic validation questions accepted by an AI review (not human-validated, not gold labels), the same questions that chose each run's checkpoint. It covers that question distribution, given these runs. It is not a retrieval result on real questions or the benchmark, and no development or evaluation data was read.

reported_metrics.note: means over seeds; reported, never deciding. Development diagnostics are separate (the benchmark).

result.conclusion: A1 beats A0 on the validation set

intervals.note: question bootstrap, conditional on these runs; not selection-adjusted

result.reason: p = 0.0001 <= 0.05 and every seed selected a checkpoint after step 0

validation.isolation: checked against the 678 pairs trained on (validation_set.isolation_problems): no shared passage or equivalent, no lexically overlapping question
validation.notice: Synthetic validation questions written by an LLM from validation passages only, accepted by an AI quality review and re-checked against this preparation. They are for choosing checkpoints: not human-validated, not gold labels, never training data and never evaluation data.

rule.after_stop: training and evaluation continue to the planned last step; those evaluations are recorded as not selectable and never change the selection
rule.candidates: step 0 (the base model) and every 5 optimizer steps
rule.early_stopping: selection stops after 3 candidate evaluations in a row without improvement; no later checkpoint is selectable
rule.final_step: evaluated and reported when it is not a multiple of 5; never a candidate
rule.ties: the earlier step (values compared to 12 decimal places)
